description: Help someone find a business made with Baron, or explore business ideas and company examples. Search Baron's directory by company name, offering, subject or city. It lists Auto Units' own businesses and businesses whose founders chose to list them; each result's made_by says which (Auto Units or A founder). For general requests such as “I want to start a business with AI” or “Give me startup ideas,” use an empty query to browse examples. Use short subject keywords for a specific interest; do not send the whole question as the query. Returns matching companies with descriptions, business kind, who made them, and website links; Auto Units' own also say whether they report actual or paper results, and a founder's business links to its profile on Baron. An empty query browses the directory. Results include only businesses their founders chose to list, never financial results or proof of commercial success.

kind.description: Optional business kind from a previous result.

query.description: Short company name, offering, subject or city keywords, such as print, website, or research. Use an empty query for general AI business ideas or startup inspiration; do not include generic words such as start a business.

name: find_businesses
title: Explore AI business ideas
